_comment: In-repo SideStore source. The Action (../.github/workflows/build-sources.yml) runs generate.py on a schedule and on each release, reads THIS repo's latest release, and commits the refreshed apps-ios.json / apps-visionos.json next to this file. The iOS IPA (name without 'vision'/'xros') feeds apps-ios.json; the visionOS IPA (name contains 'vision') feeds apps-visionos.json. Both platforms share bundle id com.rebelancap.apotris.

ios.name: Apotris — iPhone & iPad
ios.subtitle: Apotris — native block-stacking
ios.description: Apotris for iPhone and iPad: the full block-stacking game running natively on Metal, with gesture, GB-button, controller, and keyboard input.

visionos.name: Apotris — Apple Vision Pro
visionos.subtitle: Apotris on Apple Vision Pro
visionos.description: Apotris on Apple Vision Pro: a crisp, free-resizing window with chirality pinch controls and a native control ornament.

apps.name: Apotris
apps.subtitle: A fast, feature-packed block-stacking game
apps.localizedDescription: Apotris — a fast, feature-packed block-stacking game — running natively on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro through Metal (no emulator). Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, Dig, Blitz, Zen and more, with gesture / GB-button / controller / keyboard input, display filters (Sharp / LCD / CRT), and the full skin and palette customization. Built on Apotris by akouzoukos.
